nodes.headline: Learn How To Make Ads & Scale Ecommerce Brands
nodes.shortenedDescription:
Here's how you can earn passive income by making ads for ecom brands (even as a beginner):



There are millions of ecom brands online right now.



Every single one needs hundreds of ads per month just to find the few that actually work. They have the budget. They have the products.



What they don't have is people who know how to make ads that convert. That's where you come in 🫵



**✦ First, you learn the skill**  
Inside ecomtalent, there's 20+ hours of beginner-friendly training on how to make ads for ecom brands, even if you've never done it before.



**✦ Then, you practice**  
Throughout the program, you'll have action items where you practice making ads. You can then send your work for review in our Discord community, and get feedback from people who actually do this for a living.



**✦ Then you start getting paid.**  
Inside ecomtalent, there's a program called Ad Bounties. There are multiple ecom brands inside the community that need ads. You pick a brand, make an ad based on their brief, and submit it. The brand tests your ad, and if it generates sales - you earn a percentage of every sale it makes.
